notes.title: 1.0.1.10 Patch - Small Improvements
notes.notes: Just a small update, making sure the overall experience of the game is good. When you click things they feel good and so on. Also, the Chinese language got an update.

notes.title: 1.0.1.7 Patch - Bugfixes, and support for custom localization
notes.notes:
The idea with the bug reporting menu option was a jackpot. Thanks to that we were able to add some fixes:
• Extras menu pointing to "Hentai Mosaique Fix IT Shoppe" rather than "Hentai Mosaique Neko Waifus" - fixed
• The wrong image on one of Jiya-s puzzles - fixed
• Small graphical glitches when selecting solved images in a lower right-hand menu in "photos" - fixed
• The new sticky-phone functionality not working very good with the level up skill button - fixed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36555566/18182a6583fc47b9c2c03de393cd35c6c459bdb0.png

Additionally, from time to time, we get a person that wants to do a better translation for their language version of the game. To make things easier for those brave souls we have built-in customization of localization of any language available in the game. 

It's quite easy, you just need to swap files from one folder to another. Have fun with that!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36555566/db73e0bf7a4d54cddab7e6c95b7f972de88d2f9e.png

notes.title: 1.0.1.6 Patch is out - Phones in puzzle rotated simply by cursor
notes.notes:
Just a small update. 

• On puzzles that are made out of multiple rotatable phones - you can now rotate them by clicking the space just next to them (sometimes it works really good, and sometimes it's just clunky - feedback please, what do you think?).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36555566/ec27b07e4946bf8266d36cae841733354d39c0ed.gif

If you do not want to have that feature  - just uncheck it in the bottom part of the settings:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36555566/d884d78d196699452619015b9c29609c48ee94df.png

• Also one bug got fixed: Mainly sometimes the level would finish multiple times at once resulting in extra experience. That's a nice bug to have but - well, sorry it had to go.

• Airstrike of Love unlocked Earthquake achievements - fixed

• Lastly, the transition graphics look a bit different now - they are softer and not as rugged as before

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36555566/ccf7401f60ed6cb9f3cd4421d42a51a32ba53d7e.gif

notes.title: 1.0.1.2 Patch is out - Achievement Nerfs, Cards will be here soon!
notes.notes:
OK. A few things have changed

minor bug fixed:
• Sometimes after solving a puzzle you could enter it again, but it wouldn't reset or take you to the photo album, and hopefully that is fixed now
features:
• Dialogue looks a bit nicer now
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36555566/33277358d3662a435e44fd9bc867dbc594faf051.png
• Auto-mirror flip option added. By default it is turned off - meaning if you solve a mirrored puzzle you will HAVE to press the middle mouse button to mirror them. If you do not like to play like that, just head to the settings and enable auto-flip.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36555566/d28a42f381e1f367a05e3873bd31acdaeb6ae6cd.png
Achievement nerfs:

apparently the last three Achievements were way to hard to get (SONAR OF LOVE KING, AIRSTRIKE OF LOVE KING, EARTHQUAKE KING) So, they got nerfed

• SONAR OF LOVE KING changed to SONAR OF LOVE CAPTAIN (FIRE SONAR OF LOVE 25 TIMES)
• AIRSTRIKE OF LOVE KING -> AIRSTRIKE OF LOVE CAPTAIN (FIRE AIRSTRIKE OF LOVE 25 TIMES)
• EARTHQUAKE KING -> EARTHQUAKE CAPTAIN  (USE EARTHQUAKE 25 TIMES)

the cards are coming!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36555566/90bfd79bd5272000df46531366cf848c67853f74.png

notes.title: 1.0.0.9 Patch is out - bug report tool added
notes.notes:
Do you ever have the feeling, that if you only got the broken save, you could fix that bug in the game? Well that's the feeling we have when a report about an impossible to reproduce bug comes our way. But we decided to help oursleves and added a bug reporting tool - that will automagically send your broken save our way. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36555566/d9693b436c2d7116b16610504e54a61f77d38554.png

So next time something quirky happens, you know what to do!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36555566/fa141cd01ff9b11672e12223a86827784c5c9785.png

notes.title: 1.0.0.8 Patch is out
notes.notes:
Good news and good news

1. The ugly blocker bug that plagued the game for a few days is out. After you started the game - it would get stuck on skill tree tutorial and that would be the end of it. It is fixed now.

2. Cards are coming soon.

notes.title: 1.0.0.7 Patch is out
notes.notes:
Thanks to some wonderful feedback a few bugs got squished in the game, here is a short list...

What got fixed:

1. The story bit after completing the 5th and 9th level of Sayouri and Kumi gets automatically skipped / cut off - Fixed
2. White Screen bug - Sometimes the screen would go all white when going back from Skill Tree - Fixed
3. Clicking too fast while the girls are in dialogue could cause to UI to bug out  - Fixed
4. You could use arrow keys for navigating photos while in workshop mode causing the puzzle view to bug out - Fixed
5. More readable menu button highlight color - Done
6. Avatar of girl in girl menu could get stuck in animation transition - Fixed
7. Wrong Achievement names: "NEW_CLICK NUMBER 500" changed to "CLICK NUMBER 500" - Fixed
8. Skill names in achievements inconsistent with skills in the game - Fixed

notes.title: 1.0.0.6 Patch is out
notes.notes:
1.0.0.6 brings some changes. Actually bugfixes.

• bugged 3 achievements should work now
• The ordering of images in the album (Photos) was broken - that's fixed
• One of the puzzles with Sayouri and Kumi was bugged out, and that's fixed
